params.name: visible
params.description: True to show the object(s), False to hide them.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target(s) by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Shows or hides the form object(s) designated by object depending on the visible flag.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
